notes: Adaptation of the FED Funds half of Histograms.sas. Reads ALL_CORRELATIONS_RESULTS.csv, aggregates by Label via PROC SUMMARY CLASS, captures the FED mean via CALL SYMPUTX, then renders the per-cryptocurrency vbar with zero and mean reference lines. Edits: path rewritten to ./input/, PROC IMPORT takes a string literal instead of a fileref, BOM stripped from the input CSV, and fillattrs hex CX3498DB swapped for the named color steelblue.
